column4: server/admin/checkpoint_key_fuzz_test.go:FuzzCheckpointKeyFileParse — fuzzes readCheckpointKeyFile's hex-then-base64 --checkpoint-key-file decode against arbitrary bytes on a real temp file; asserts the documented decode precedence, refusal on empty/unparseable content, and no non-nil key on a refused read; narrower than a full package dive (one function). Plus the verify-audit command (audit_verify.go: flag/config/anchor resolution, key-file decode, target open and lock, report): finding VERIFY-AUDIT-NEVER-WRITTEN (low, the report called erased checkpoints never written; server/admin/audit_verify_review_test.go:TestVerifyAudit_ErasedCheckpointsNotReportedAsNeverWritten, red on main), the --db URI-path finding fixed in internal/auditverify. Package stays targeted: restore, backup and the other admin commands were not part of this pass (~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-AUDITVERIFY-KEYFILES-1.md item 4)
